falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern assumed a higher low formation; breaking 4,800 would violate the structural support level of that pattern and confirm continuation lower, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled volatility/early recovery phase; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation inconsistent with bottoming behavior and would signal the pattern match failed

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further by more than 15 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred during yield curve normalization; deepening inversion would indicate deteriorating macro conditions that invalidate the 'bottom' analog and confirm recessionary divergence from the matched pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
